escrow_created_subject: Your order escrow has been created
escrow_created_body: Your escrow for order {{orderId}} has been created. Funds of {{amount}} are held securely until your order from {{merchant}} is confirmed.
escrow_released_body: Great news! The escrow for order {{orderId}} has been released. A payment of {{amount}} has been sent to {{merchant}}.
escrow_refunded_body: Your escrow for order {{orderId}} has been refunded. {{amount}} will be returned to your account.
escrow_disputed_body: A dispute has been opened for order {{orderId}} with {{merchant}}. Our team will review the situation. Funds of {{amount}} remain in escrow.
payment_failed_body: Unfortunately, your payment of {{amount}} for order {{orderId}} to {{merchant}} has failed. Please review your payment details and try again.
permission_granted_body: You have granted {{delegate}} permission to act on your behalf for purchases up to {{amount}}. This permission can be revoked at any time.
permission_revoked_body: The spending permission previously granted to {{delegate}} by {{owner}} has been revoked. No further transactions can be made under this permission.
permission_expiry_updated_body: The expiry date for the spending permission granted to {{delegate}} by {{owner}} has been updated. New expiry: {{newExpiry}}.
transaction_approval_body: Your AI agent is requesting approval to complete order {{orderId}} for {{amount}} from {{merchant}}. Please review and approve at: {{approvalUrl}}
sms_out_for_delivery_body: Delego: your order {{orderId}} is out for delivery today. Tracking: {{trackingNumber}}.
sms_auto_release_warning_subject: Escrow for order {{orderId}} will be released soon
sms_auto_release_warning_body: Delego: escrow for order {{orderId}} (tracking {{trackingNumber}}) will be released to the merchant soon. If there is a problem with your delivery, open a dispute before then.
sms_refund_processed_body: Delego: the refund for order {{orderId}} (tracking {{trackingNumber}}) has been processed.
